id./param/scenario/cs/b_040_cs_010.pack|cs_: "Hm! A traveler is being attacked by a monster!
"Hey, {var:1}, let's go help!
"You naughty monster! Stop attacking innocent people!
"...Dear me. You need a good punishing.
"Hyaaah!!
"Eeee!! So cool!!
"As expected of Sylvando! What graceful moves! So beautiful!!
"...Oh my.
"Could it be...
"It's {var:1}!!!
"...Who are these people? Friends of {var:1}? What are they doing?
"What, can't you tell? It's obvious!
"To bring back the world's...
"smile!!
"So to light up the dark world, I've been marching the world over in my Parade of Smiles.
"They're my dear companions! They joined the parade on the road out of sympathy.
"Still, after all that, you two are alive! A miracle! I'm so happy to see {var:1} again!
"Um, excuse me...
"Oh! Sorry for leaving you! Are you hurt?
"Not a scratch, thanks to you. You dress oddly, but you sure are strong.
"I'm Da. I came from Phnom Nonh in the south. You saved my life. Thank you.
"Oh my. Then we'll see you home to Phnom Nonh!
"Now, {var:1}, we'll think about what's next later...
"Why not join our Parade of Smiles for a little while?
"Oh, come on! You're itching with curiosity really. Don't be shy!
"Yes! That's {var:1} for you!
"Now let's open the door to a new world! Try this on!
"Eee! Gorgeous! My eye never fails!
"Everyone! This is the famous {var:1} who adventured with me!
"Now, {var:1} is the boss of our Parade of Smiles!
"Everyone, follow {var:1}!!"
